saw_lines: Supplement buyers read the label, check the taste and reorder only what fits their routine.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides if the product fits their routine.
Your 12 of 28 ads use claim words like clinically and guaranteed results, which narrows reach. Swap them for what customers noticed in week one and drop them from line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: 12 of your 28 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, which invites Meta review and narrows who sees them. Swap those for what customers noticed in the first week and drop them from line one.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before the click. Collect one real count, such as orders shipped, and put it on the creative in the next batch.

11 of your 28 copy ads are creator posts, with codes, #ad tags and @mentions, run from your brand page. Whitelist them from the creator accounts so they run as partner ads, then cut three variations of one creator post.

Your 28 copy ads open with 19 different stories, and the cravings, bloating and stubborn fat line leads 5 of them. That split leaves every angle thin. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Two hook stories rebuilt for L-Carnitine and Lean Body, claims swapped for customer notes
